وتأتي هذه المشاركة امتدادا لجهود ميثاق ا: This participation extends the Family Pledge's efforts to build bridges with institutions and communities around the world, introduce more families to its message, and widen the network of supporters committed to its cause in Bangkok and beyond.

ويأتي إطلاق المركز بهدف تزويد النساء الل: The centre was launched to equip women who provide for their families with practical skills and craft training that enable them to set up small income-generating projects, contributing to their economic independence and preserving their families' dignity amid the harsh living conditions the Strip is going through.
وجاء اختيار مجالات التدريب بناء على دراس: The training fields were chosen on the basis of a survey and social assessment carried out by Family Pledge teams, covering 200 women breadwinners in the area, to identify their needs and the opportunities that suit them best. وقد تم تجهيز المركز بكافة المستلزمات وال: The centre has been fitted out with all the necessary modern supplies and equipment, including 5 advanced sewing machines (among them an overlock machine) and a fully equipped tailoring and cutting table, along with a training hall fitted with a display screen and an interactive whiteboard.
وشهد حفل الافتتاح حضورا لافتا ومشاركة عب: The opening ceremony drew a notable attendance, with partners and supporters from Malaysia and countries of Asia and the Pacific taking part by video link.
وتخلل الفعالية استعراض قصص نجاح ملهمة لس: The event included inspiring success stories of women who benefited from earlier empowerment programmes. “Reham” shared her experience with the women present, and light was shed on the story of one breadwinner who, through her own project, moved from need and reliance on aid to being a productive woman who supports her family with dignity.
من جانبها، أعربت الدكتورة فوزية (من مالي: For her part, Dr Fauziah (from Malaysia), taking part online, expressed her happiness at the launch, stressing that the choice of the name “Warda” carries deep meanings that express strength, beauty and hope. She added: “As the rose spreads its fragrance, we hope the impact of this centre will reach far and blossom into good and benefit for the whole surrounding community.”
